ns2:section.sectionText: General and Industrial Engineering students must obtain Chief Advisor approval (104 Trans Bldg) to drop after the second week of instruction. Restricted to students in the College of Engineering.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to General Engineering or Industrial Engineering or Materials Science & Engr or Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering or Bioengineering or Aerospace Engineering or Agricultural & Biological Engr or Systems Engineering and Design major(s).
